text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought the injured Kiseki
to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry.
But really, I'm totally fine!
choice_data_list: Just to be safe, why don't we call it a day and rest?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer!
There's something I'd like to consult you about—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little! Just a bit is fine,
so would you let me train?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I believe there are still things you can do even when injured...
Just like Takeru in "Silver Diamond"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! He's the main character
from my favorite baseball manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
Kiseki
text_block_list.text: She looked so positive and radiant...! I want to chase after my dreams just like that too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So please, Trainer!
Please train me...!
choice_data_list: First, let's properly heal that injury.
If you promise it's just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our top priority is ensuring Kiseki stays healthy.
We can't let our guard down, even with the smallest injury.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mrmph... Is that really what I should do...?
choice_data_list: Let's put that ambition to use after you heal your injury!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh...! I see, using this frustration as a springboard, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then I need to rest up this time...
so this injury heals as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
All right...! I've gotta fire myself up and do this!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please let me rest for a bit...
Ugh, am I just not cut out for this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her injury had worsened...
It seemed like it would take time for a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! 
Alright, looking good...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If it's like this,
I think I can train little by little!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's all thanks to 'The Silver Diamond'!
...Oh, Trainer, would you like to read it
with me sometime? Pretty please!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, while continuing her training, Kiseki aimed for a full recovery!
